# A link to neomjs.com shows no image where it is shared

## Context

Outbound reaches people as links to neomjs.com: the blog posts, the Portal's pages, and on Mon 2026-11-23 the release-day post of Engine 14 (#21041). LinkedIn, X, Slack and Discord draw a pasted link from the page's Open Graph tags. A link without an image is drawn as a line of text.

## The Problem

No page of the site names an image. Read on 2026-11-16 with LinkedIn's crawler user agent (`LinkedInBot/1.0`):

| Address | `og:` tags in the answer |
|---|---|
| `https://neomjs.com/` | `og:title`, `og:description`, `og:type`, `og:url`, `og:site_name` |
| `https://neomjs.com/news/blog` | the same five |

Neither answer holds an `og:image` or a `twitter:card`.

## The Architectural Reality

- `apps/portal/index.html` (lines 9 to 13 on `dev`) holds the five tags and no image.
- The site's server (neomjs/middleware-v2, `src/service/SsrService.mjs`) builds each route's head from that file. It copies every `<meta>` except charset and viewport, and rewrites `og:title`, `og:description`, `og:url` and `robots` per route from `apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json`. A tag it does not know is copied as it stands, so one `og:image` in `index.html` reaches every route with no change to the server.
- `seo.json` holds a title and a description per route (written by `buildScripts/docs/seo/`) and no image. `apps/portal/resources/data/blog.json` holds no cover per post.
- No file in the repository is a share image. The logo is `resources/images/logo/neo_logo_text_primary.svg`.

## The Fix

1. **One image**, 1200 × 627 px, PNG, in the Portal's resources, built from what the site already shows: the logo and the words of the page's title. It adds no new line about Neo; a new line would be an identity change, which has a process of its own.
2. **`apps/portal/index.html`** gains `og:image` (the image's absolute `https://neomjs.com/…` address), `og:image:width`, `og:image:height`, `og:image:alt` and `twitter:card` with the value `summary_large_image`.
3. Nothing else: the server copies the tags.

It serves the release-day outbound only if it is on `dev` before the Engine 14 cut (#21033).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: the image is in the repository at 1200 × 627 px and under 300 KB, and the pull request shows it.
- [ ] AC-2: `apps/portal/index.html` carries the five new tags, and the image's address in them is absolute.
- [ ] AC-3, after the site's next deploy: read with `LinkedInBot/1.0`, `https://neomjs.com/`, one blog post and one learn route each answer with the `og:image` tag, and the image's address answers 200 as `image/png` in a browser.
- [ ] AC-4, after the deploy, a human step: LinkedIn's Post Inspector shows the image for `https://neomjs.com/`. It needs a signed-in LinkedIn account, so it is the operator's read, asked for by the implementer on this ticket.

## Out of Scope

- An image per route or per blog post. That is a field in `seo.json` and a reader in the server; the blog covers have their own ticket (neomjs/neo-agent-skills#304).
- The contributor badge records, which are static pages outside the Portal (neomjs/pages#92).
- New wording about Neo on the image.

## Avoided Traps

- **An SVG as the image.** LinkedIn and X draw PNG or JPEG.
- **A relative address.** The crawlers need the absolute one.
- **Changing the server first.** It already copies the tag.

## Related

#21041 (the release-day post and its outbound), #21033 (the cut), #20671 (search engines and agents find the site; its scope leaves outbound distribution out), neomjs/neo-agent-skills#304 (blog covers).
